title: Per-Entity Lua Environment Isolation
description: Each Lua script instance gets its own environment table with __index = _G metatable. Scripts can READ all globals (uz.*, math.*, string.*) but any variable SET is isolated to their environment. This prevents scripts from accidentally polluting each other's state while sharing the uz.* API.
whenToUse: When loading any per-entity Lua script. When implementing new script types (behaviors, AI, UI scripts).
whenNotToUse: For engine-level Lua modules that intentionally need to share state. For debug console commands that should modify global state.
